articles.title: Tennis Says: Same Big Prize Money for Women and Men
articles.summary: Starting next year, women and men will win the same prize money at all the biggest tennis events outside the Grand Slams. That includes the Italian Open, Canadian Open and Cincinnati Open. The WTA says it's a major milestone for fairness.

articles.title: A Lion in a Banana-Leaf Hat: Meet the Mascot of Africa's First Olympics
articles.summary: The 2026 Youth Olympic Games are coming to Senegal — the first Olympics ever held in Africa. About 2,700 young athletes will compete, and the mascot is a lion named Ayo, designed by a 16-year-old student.

articles.title: Pokémon Fans Take Over San Francisco
articles.summary: 50,000 Pokémon fans filled San Francisco for the World Championships. Kid Reporter Adam met a champion who practices all the time, and even saw a life-size motorcycle Pokémon blink!
